mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper identifies ZY200177 as lucifensin, a Lucilia sericata defensin; Figure 1 and PDF text provide the mature 40-aa peptide sequence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Identity and sequence are supported; this is not a mode-of-action assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lucifensin shows in vitro antibacterial activity against tested Gram-positive bacteria and no observed activity against the tested Gram-negative bacteria at the highest Table 2 concentration.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper reports antibacterial phenotype, not a resolved molecular target or killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lucifensin was predicted by fold recognition/homology modeling to adopt the conserved cysteine-stabilized alpha-helix/beta-sheet defensin fold with disulfide bridges inferred by homology.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural fold is inferred by homology in this paper; do not promote this to a direct mechanism claim.

ontology_review_notes: Removed automated biofilm/quorum/nucleic-acid/cell-wall placeholder claims because they were context from cited literature or method text, not direct lucifensin mechanism evidence in this paper.
Bounded mechanism output to identity, purification, MIC phenotype, and inferred defensin structural context supported by local XML/PDF/OA-package evidence.
